full_judgment:
Hasan Foez Siddique, J: This appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 31-1-2010 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.15653 of 2008 discharging the Rule. 

 2. The appellant filed the above mentioned Criminal Miscellaneous case praying for quashment of the proceeding of GR Case No. 24 of 2007 corresponding to Chandina Police Station Case No.11 dated 21-2-2007 under sections 468/471/409/120 of the Penal Code and section 5 of the Prevention of Corruption Act. The said case was started against this accused-appellant on an FIR lodged by Md Shahirar Khan, Sub-Inspector of Police, Chandina Police Station, District-Comilla alleging that on getting secret information that the accused appellant, chairman of Kharan Khal Union Parishad, had misappropriated some CI sheets. Getting such information, he rushed to Dotla Islamia Dakhil Madrasha and found that 17 pieces CI sheets were kept on the floor of that Madrasha. Abdus Sattar, superintendent of the said madrasha and other witnesses told the informant that accused Md Abu Taher had handed over 36 pieces of CI sheets to the Madrasha superintendent and out of those 36 pieces of CI sheets, 19 pieces had been used for roofing the shed of Madrasha. The informant then seized those 36 pieces CI sheets by preparing seizure-list in presence of witnesses. Thereafter, he lodged the FIR. 

 3. On the basis of the said FIR the instant case was started. The accused petitioner appearing in the Court, obtained bail and, thereafter, filed application under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure in the High Court Division. The High Court Division issued Rule but finally after hearing the parties discharged the Rule. Against which, the appellant has preferred this appeal upon getting leave. 

 4. Mr Toufiq Hossain, learned Advocate-on-Record appearing for the appellant, submits that the prosecution papers show that the petitioner as chairman sanctioned only 36 pieces of CI sheets in favour of the Madrasha and Madrasha authority, taking delivery those CI sheets used 19 pieces for its tin-shed, kept the rests in their custody and the petitioner did not misappropriate even a single piece of those CI sheets, so, filing of the instant case was malafide, preposturous and had been brought only to harass the appellant which is liable to be quashed. He submits that the whole prosecution story is accepted as true, the same does not disclose any offence of misappropriation against the petitioner. 

 5. Mr Khurshid Alam Khan, learned Advocate appearing for the Dumity Daman Commission, submits that the prosecution papers disclosed prima-facie case against the petitioner, the High Court Division rightly discharged the Rule finding such prima-facie case, the appeal should be dismissed. 

 9. The expression "harm" has not been defined in the Penal Code. Section 95 is intended to prevent penalization of negligible wrongs or of offences of trivial character. The object of provide such section was to exclude from the operation of the Penal Code those cases which from the imperfection of language may fall within the letter of the law, but are not within its spirit and are considered, and for the most part dealt with by the Courts, as innocent. The provision is intended to prevent penalization of negligible wrongs or of offences of trival character. In Veeda Menezes vs Yusuf Khan Hazi Ibrahim Khan, AIR 1966 SC 1776 it was observed, 

 11. That is, admittedly, he did not misappropriate those CI sheets and those were not recovered from his custody and control. That was a trivial matter that has been given undue importance. Moreover, in the meantime 14 years has elapsed. After 14 years, it will not be appreciatable for a ordinary prudent and senseable man to allow the instant case to proceed with. Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case, the FIR and other prosecution papers taken in pursuance thereof, would be an abuse of the process of Court. 

 Accordingly, we find substance in the appeal. Thus, the appeal is allowed. The instant GR Case is dropped.
